a.xlink:title: companies One company can play several roles (Honda: engine manufacturer + constructor + entrant).
constructors Designer of the FIA "Listed Parts" (the chassis). It has no lineage: lineage belongs to entrants. Includes specialist builders (Lola, Dallara).
chassis A chassis model. The same chassis can be raced by many entrants (customers, privateers).
engineManufacturers Builds engines. Also used as the BRAND of a rebadged engine (Ford on a Cosworth, TAG Heuer on a Renault).
engines An engine model, parsed from the old free-text names, e.g. "Energy F1 2014 V6 t h 1.6" = name Energy F1 2014, V6, 1.6 l, turbocharged, hybrid.
entrants Who registers and runs the cars (the "team", e.g. Tyrrell 1966-98); its identity holds for the whole history. The registered names, sponsors included, live in entries.entrantName.
entrantSuccessions Handover of a team to another entrant. A chain: tyrrell-racing -> bar (1999) -> honda-racing (2006) -> brawn-gp (2009) -> mercedes (2010).
entrantSeasons Facts of an entrant that hold for a whole season. The sponsor name is NOT here, since it can change within a season (Ferrari 2021): see entries.entrantName.
entries A driver in a car configuration, reused by the results of any session (it was never per session). Any change of number, name, chassis, engine or tyres is a new row.
